description: A component that renders content within the safe area boundaries of a device, preventing overlap with notches, rounded corners, status bars, and navigation bars.

data.name: style
data.description: Applies layout and visual styling. Commonly used with flex: 1.

data.name: edges
data.description: Specifies which screen edges to apply safe area insets (top, bottom, left, right).

data.name: mode
data.description: Controls how safe area is applied (padding or margin).

data.name: children
data.description: Nested components rendered inside the safe area.

data.name: flex
data.description: Usually set to 1 to occupy the full screen.

data.name: SafeAreaProvider
data.description: Wrap the root app component with SafeAreaProvider for proper context.

data.name: Avoid Padding
data.description: Avoid manual padding on SafeAreaView as it may conflict with automatic insets.

data.name: Missing Provider
data.description: Not wrapping the app with SafeAreaProvider can cause incorrect insets.

example.title: Basic SafeAreaView Example
example.description: A simple layout that respects device safe areas.

code.snippet:
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

<SafeAreaView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#fff' }}>
  <Text>Hello Safe Area</Text>
</SafeAreaView>
